name: Design of Intelligent Digital Integrated Circuits and Systems
description: Examines device and circuit level optimization of digital building blocks. Topics include MOS device models with Deep Sub-Micron effects; circuit design styles for logic, arithmetic and sequential blocks; energy consumption estimation and minimization; interconnect models and parasitic effects; device sizing and logical effort; timing issues including clock skew and jitter; active clock distribution techniques; memory architectures, circuits and devices; integrated circuit testing. Employs extensive use of circuit layout and SPICE in design projects, and covers machine learning and cryptography for system-level design.
